rules.affiliations: Pinned relation schema accepts a free-text name without an ID. Keep each source affiliation/location as one exact name. No ROR lookup, invented identifier, affiliation splitting or source change.
rules.personal_readback_name: Pinned RDM post_load creates name as family_name + comma-space + given_name; request omits name. If present on readback it must equal that exact canonical display. Missing/altered given/family fields hold.
rules.personal_required: type personal and nonblank family_name; this finite projection supplies both reviewed given_name and family_name
rules.prior2733: Their request wire and all nonruntime evidence remain exact. Old organizational readback restrictions stay effective.
rules.readback_defaults: Only known empty identifiers may accompany an exact affiliation name or person. Reject unexpected fields, IDs, roles, extra/reordered affiliations or creators.
